title: Amazing and fun segways
text: Wow. Simply wow. We did the 3 hour tour and had so much fun. The Segways are a fantastic means of travelling about. Sevilla is very accommodating with cycle lanes which can be used. Marcio our tour lead was very informative and he made the trip even more enjoyable. So much fun. Fantastic value for money. Thoroughly recommend this.
author: BrightonCurryking

title: Historical Guide 3 hour
text: We had Barry as our guide. Very informative and interesting tour. Great knowledge and a nice easy going guy. Would highly recommend.
author: Maps442683

title: Wonderful 3 hours tour
text: Very nice and relaxing tour. We enjoyed it enormously, good time to explore the many different places we visited. Our guide Zack was very friendly and extremely knowledgeable elaborated on al the history and a lot of fun facts. He also knew the best spots for photos.
author: stinemeno

title: 3 hour tour
text: We had a fantastic 3hour tour which flew by. Barry was an excellent guide with a wealth of knowledge delivered in good humour. He is also fab with a camera, got some lovely shots for us. Would definitely recommend.
author: Maps440221

title: A fun and great experience!
text: A great experience!, Barry is great and makes the tour very fun it gets short, it is better than walking and you see a lot of things impossible to see otherwise. Highly recommended, we will repeat!!!
author: Abilea74

title: 10/10 tour!
text: Superb tour of Seville; great, relaxed guide, very informative. Lots of fun riding the Segway. Lots of background to each location. What a beautiful way to see the city!
author: Maps719652

title: Fantastic
text: Billal was a great guide, great overview of Seville and its important landmarks. Was a very hot day but Billal made sure we were ok and rested in shade. Highly recommend.
author: Fran o

title: Awesome Segway tour and highlights of the city!!
text: Had an amazing tour of the city highlights on a private Segway tour. Our son was able to do it at 13, so he was very happy. The tour company reached out early in the day to see if we could start earlier so that we could get into one of the sites before they closed as there was a private concert being held that night. We were able to adjust and met at their store to get suited with helmets and our training on the Segway. After 5-10 minutes we were off on the tour. We saw all the major sites on our 3 hr tour. title: Segway is the way to see Sevilla!
text: To sum it up, YOU HAVE GOT TO DO THIS TOUR if you go to Sevilla!  Marcio is the best!   The tour is long and you get to see the best parts of the city.   And you are on a Segway which is super fun!
author: C7810PPbeng

title: 3 hour segway tour of Sevilla
text: Great way to explore Sevilla when on a short break.  Thanks Bilal for an informative and fun afternoon
